content: We need to find a template that when applied retrosynthetically to the given molecule reproduces the forward reaction: aromatic amine attacks phenylsulfonyl chloride, forming sulfonamide, breaking S-Cl bond, forming N-S bond. So we need a template where functional_groups_formed includes sulfonamides, functional_groups_broken includes sulfonyl chloride? Actually forward reaction: sulfonyl chloride (S-Cl) reacts with amine to give sulfonamide (N-S) and Cl- leaves. So in forward reaction, sulfonyl chloride functional group is broken (S-Cl) and sulfonamide formed. So we search templates with functional_groups_broken: "sulfonyl chloride"? The list includes "acyl chloride", "sulfonic", "sulfonamides". Not sure if "sulfonyl chloride" is a functional group in list. Might be "acyl chloride" for carbonyl, but for sulfonyl maybe "sulfonyl chloride". Not listed. Could use bonds broken: "S-Cl". So we can search with bonds_broken: "S-Cl". Also bonds_formed: "N-S". Let's try search_template_catalog_by_criteria with those.
